idea-plugin.name: FactoryLine AI Proof
idea-plugin.description:
Verify AI code before you ship.

FactoryLine turns tests, requirements, policies, and build evidence into local proof you can inspect in your JetBrains IDE.

Start here

  1. Open Tools | FactoryLine | Run First Proof.
  2. Confirm the current workspace.
  3. Review the local setup result in the FactoryLine tool window.

Know what is safe to ship

  • Check changed code: see which proof is invalidated by your current diff.
  • Verify receipts: inspect local evidence before a release decision.
  • Measure real savings: compare paired time, token, and cost data without inferred values.
  • Run supervised workflows: assemble features, continue from safe boundaries, inspect durable mission graphs, and route secret-free BYOK policies.
  • Follow the exact evidence path: Unified Graph Ops visualizes local requirements, slices, missions, approvals, completions, proofs, gates, traces, and artifacts without executing them.

Local by design

The plugin asks before running a command. It does not upload project files or receipts, store API keys, sign artifacts, or decide whether a release is ready.

Works with IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, Rider, CLion, GoLand, RustRover, and DataGrip from the 2025.2 platform baseline.

Launch offer

All features are free through December 31, 2026. FactoryLine AI Proof is planned to become a paid Marketplace plugin on January 1, 2027 at $4.95 USD per month, subject to JetBrains approval, with a planned 30-day trial. Version 0.8.0 and the open-source repository remain available. The payment change adds no telemetry, source upload, credential storage, signing authority, or automatic release authority.

Free and open source. Read the documentation or inspect the source.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Add Unified Graph Ops: a local, read-only visual map with one fact-derived next action.
  • Add Run First Proof for a zero-configuration local setup check.
  • Clarify the Marketplace name, preview, getting-started flow, and privacy boundary.
  • Keep the stable plugin ID and verified compatibility across eight JetBrains IDEs.
